description: Source code for a class implementing a code parser that processes files into code blocks, supports markdown and various programming languages, and handles chunking and parsing logic.

classes.name: CodeParser
classes.description: Implements the ICodeParser interface to parse code files into semantic code blocks, supporting multiple languages and markdown.

methods.name: parseFile
methods.description: Asynchronously reads and parses a code file into code blocks, supports content options.

methods.name: isSupportedLanguage
methods.description: Checks if a file extension corresponds to a supported language.

methods.name: createFileHash
methods.description: Generates a SHA-256 hash for file content.

methods.name: parseContent
methods.description: Parses file content into code blocks, handling markdown, fallback chunking, and language parsing.

methods.name: _performFallbackChunking
methods.description: Chunks large text content into smaller segments based on line splitting.

methods.name: _chunkLeafNodeByLines
methods.description: Chunks a tree-sitter node's text into line-based segments.

methods.name: processMarkdownSection
methods.description: Processes markdown sections into code blocks with chunking.

methods.name: parseMarkdownContent
methods.description: Parses markdown content, extracting headers and sections, and chunks accordingly.

methods.name: _chunkTextByLines
methods.description: Chunks an array of lines into code blocks, managing oversized lines and rebalancing.
